spans.s: Keśarin^1, name of a monkey, v. Kesarin.
Keśarin^2, a mountain in Śākadvīpa. § 575b (Śākadvīpa): VI, 11, 424 (only C., B. has Kesaraḥ, q.v.).

Kesarin (Keśº, C.), name of a monkey. § 425 (HanūmadBhīmasenasaṃv.): III, 147, 11193 (Hanūmat was begotten by Vāyu with the wife of K.).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 68, †3402 (ºṇaḥ sutasya, i.e. Hanūmat, on the banner of Arjuna).
Keśavāgraja (“the elder brother of Keśava” [i.e. Kṛshṇa]) = Balarāma: IX, 2062, 3135.
Keśavanandana (“the son of Keśava” [i.e. Kṛshṇa]) = Pradyumna: III, 723, 754.
Keśavapūrvaja (“the elder brother of Keśava” [i.e. Kṛshṇa]) = Balarāma: IX, 1965, 2978.

Keśin^1, an Asura. § 92 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 65, 2531 (son of Danu).--§ 495 (Skandotpatti): III, 223, 14248, (14251), 14252, 14253, 14254; 224, 14257, 14259 (mahāsuraḥ; K. had ravished Daityasenā, but was defeated by Indra when he tried to ravish Devasenā).--§ 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 69, 2031 (had been slain by Kṛshṇa).--§ 793 (Mausalap.): XVI, 6, 158 (do.).
Keśin^2, § 412 (Ashṭāvakrīya): III, 134, 10670 (?, trayodaśāhāni sasāra Keśī; agnir vāyuḥ sūryaś ca keśinaḥ iti vaidikaprasiddheḥ, Nīl.).
Keśinī^1, an Apsaras. § 103 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 65, 2558 (daughter of Prādhā and Kaśyapa).
Keśinī^2, wife of Ajamīḍha. § 152 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3722 (mother of Jahnu, Vrajana, and Rūpin).
Keśinī^5, § 558 (Virocana): V, 35, 1185, 1186, 1187, (1188), 1189, (1190), 1193, 1194 (the dispute of Virocana and Sudhanvan on account of K.).
Kesara, a mountain in Śākadvīpa. § 575b (Śākadvīpa): VI, 11, 424 (only B., C. has Keśarī), 427 (only B., C. has Kedārasya).
